v4.6.85 — Fix the update loop (installer hang on ARM64 / Windows 11)

🐛 FIXED
• The in-app update could hang and never finish — the silent installer engaged the Windows Restart Manager (/CLOSEAPPLICATIONS /RESTARTAPPLICATIONS), which stalled on ARM64 / Windows 11. The app then reopened at the old version and kept prompting to update (the loop). The updater no longer uses Restart Manager — it force-kills APEX itself (twice) and relaunches after install, so updates apply cleanly.

⚠️ ONE-TIME STEP TO ESCAPE THE LOOP: because your CURRENT version still has the old updater, install THIS version once by hand — download APEX_Setup.exe from the release page and double-click it (a normal install doesn't use Restart Manager). After that, in-app updates work normally again.
